$comment: Budgets are gzipped JavaScript, in kilobytes, enforced by scripts/check-bundle-size.js in CI. Raising a number is a deliberate decision — say why in the PR.

firstLoadShared.description: JS every page pays for: the framework, shared chunks and the root layout.

perRoute.description: First-load JS for any single route, shared chunks included.

totalClient.description: Every client chunk the build emits, added up.

routeOverrides.$comment: Routes that legitimately exceed perRoute. Each needs a reason.

/(dashboard)/settings.reason: Account, security, wallet and privacy panels on one page; the heavy panels are lazy-loaded but the shell is still large.
